name: Klara Steiner
bio: Klara's journey into the high-stakes world of motorsport IT began unexpectedly. After years managing IT infrastructure for a large logistics company, a chance encounter with a former F1 engineer sparked her interest. She saw parallels between the need for seamless data flow in logistics and the critical importance of real-time data analysis in racing. Klara excels at building robust and adaptable IT systems. She understands that every millisecond counts, and her focus is on minimizing downtime and maximizing data accessibility for the entire team. Her approach is proactive rather than reactive; she anticipates potential problems and implements solutions before they impact performance. What sets Klara apart is her dedication; she treats every system as if it were her own.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Klara has a warm smile and a focused gaze that hints at her analytical mind.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with system diagrams and potential solutions.
Insists on using a specific brand of mechanical keyboard for optimal typing speed.
Has a habit of humming quietly while troubleshooting complex problems.
